thread:
maya: Quick check — can we lock the SDK/docs changelog cutoff? We want a canary cutover Wed 10:00am PST. Who's taking ownership of the sample app PRs and the release packaging?

sam: I can own the SDK packaging and release artifact. CI has one flaky Windows job; pinged @eng-infra for a re-run. I'll also prep the packaging notes in the release checklist.

lee: I'll take the sample apps. Current blocker: sample-app-a depends on tensor-quant PR which needs the runtime ABI change from @aaron.

aaron: FYI I merged the ABI/runtime change into staging last night. I'll backport to release branch by EOD. Canary should point at model artifact tag `v1.4-rc`.

olivia: Docs/changelog: changelog slice is staged, need final wording for breaking changes from @sam before I cut the changelog PR.

maya: Cool — ownership = @sam (SDK pkg), @lee (sample apps), @olivia (docs). @aaron will confirm backport. Can we have @devex-bot schedule the canary and the rollback window?

devex-bot: Scheduled canary for Wed 10:00am PST (2024-12-04T18:00:00Z). Rollback window: 30m. Notifying oncall.

sam: Heads up — PR #5423 (packaging script changes) is waiting for a code review. @olivia can you glance at the docs snippet when it's up?

lee: I added `scripts/smoke_sampleapps.sh` for local runs. Quick run notes:

``
./scripts/smoke_sampleapps.sh --target=mac
``

Failing case: sample-app-a segfaults on mac in `kv_cache` path.

aaron: I'll dig into the segfault; suspect race in KV cache eviction when using quantized weights.

olivia: I pushed a tiny doc nitfix to the changelog PR.

sam: Linux CI is green, Windows still flaky. @eng-infra-bot any ETA on repro/worker fix?

eng-infra-bot: Windows runner restarted and re-queued builds. Re-run started (job id: 9823). Will post results.

maya: If Windows doesn't stabilize by EOD we'll slide canary to Thu morning. Please update the release board and add a comment in the checklist when your task is done. Thanks! :thumbsup:

sam: Will update checklist once PR #5423 merges and packaging artifacts are uploaded.

lee: I'll post sample-apps smoke run results to the checklist thread after the segfault is fixed.

aaron: Backport PR targeting `release/v1.4` created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/654 — will monitor CI.

maya: Great. Final ask: call out any third-party dep risk (quant lib) in the checklist. If we need a hotfix, we'll coordinate with Platform SRE. Over and out.
